suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy on a Friday afternoon that actually went smooth, no rollback needed.
I'm thankful for the makcik at the kopitiam who still gives me extra kuah even when I don't ask.
I'm grateful for finding the root cause of a bug after three days of staring at logs, right before I gave up.
I'm thankful for the LRT being on time on the one day I actually woke up late.
I'm grateful for the stillness right before Fajr, before the group chats start blowing up.
I'm thankful for my dad still calling just to ask if I've eaten, even though I'm 26.
I'm grateful for a code review that caught a bug before it hit production, not after.
I'm thankful for teh tarik that's actually tarik-ed properly, not just poured from one cup to another.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a job that still pays on time every month, nothing fancy, just steady.
I'm thankful for a manager who said "go home, it can wait till Monday" and meant it.
I'm grateful for the unexpected rain that cooled down the whole flat without me touching the aircon remote.
I'm thankful for a staging bug that showed up before the client's demo instead of during it.
I'm grateful for my grandmother's voice notes that are way too long but somehow never boring.
I'm thankful for a Friday khutbah that actually hit different this week.
I'm grateful for the junior dev on my team asking good questions, reminding me I used to ask the same ones.
